newsitem.title: UK: Royal Sun says sees improved Q1 profits.
newsitem.headline: Royal Sun says sees improved Q1 profits.

text.p: Royal & Sun Alliance Insurance Group plc said on Friday that it expected first quarter results to show an improvement over the same period last year which were affected by severe weather losses in the U.S.
The figures are due to be released on May 20.
Royal & Sun was formed in a six million stg merger of Royal Insurance and Sun Alliance Insurance last May.
Analysts will be closely watching the first quarter for further indications on how the integration is progressing and action regarding the proposed buyback of five percent of the group's shares.
